top.line: RiskMandate and Kosmoy compared: a control plane for regulated enterprises and an open behaviour policy per agent.
top.para: Where they overlap, differ and fit.

in-short.line: Kosmoy enforces at gateway and pod; RiskMandate writes the policy, starts at £0, and anyone can build it in.

kosmoy.line: Inventory, an AI gateway with guardrails and routing, observability, and a Kubernetes sandbox per run.
kosmoy.para: Self-hosted, by proposal; Banca d'Italia and Leonardo named.

riskmandate.line: An open behaviour policy per agent, hooks on every call, SHarness at the kernel; £0 to start, help from £500.

overlap.line: Both know what agents reach, decide what they may do, block, record and stop.
overlap.para: The capsule and SHarness are cousins.

differ.line: Infrastructure first against the agent first; enterprises against anyone; proposal against fixed prices; closed against open.

fit.line: A behaviour policy is what Kosmoy's gateway and capsules could enforce; the reports show if it held.

limits.line: Kosmoy from its website, not used; RiskMandate is ours; neither is a certification.

sources.line: kosmoy.com and riskmandate.ai, read 18 November 2026, and earlier articles.

open.line: All of it is open source, so Kosmoy or anyone could support behaviour policies natively; that is the goal.
open.para: Nobody can lock customers in, including us.
